ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1.1 white-to-black pixel ratio across visible surfaces; high-intensity values dominate the left lobe (approx. 75% white) while low-intensity values dominate the right lobe (approx. 85% black).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe shows a contiguous white field with dark speckling concentrated near the trailing edge and proximal midline. Right lobe is characterized by a solid black field with sparse, isolated white micro-spots near the distal margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations along the continuous linear boundary of both trailing edges, appearing as sharp peaks and valleys against the sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature fitted to the outer edges of both lobes leading to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive high-contrast brown/tan circular pixel clusters (sessile barnacles) densely populated along the distal margins of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the proximal-medial high-intensity surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle infestation on distal tips; irregular and deeply serrated trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme pigmentation asymmetry between the two lobes; left lobe is predominantly white/light-gray, while the right lobe is predominantly black.
